mentions.name: App 2.0 complete rewrite (unnamed)
mentions.description: Version 2.0 of an app that has been shipping for a couple of years, rebuilt completely from front end to back end with substantial LLM assistance. Currently in the final stages of first-wave testing covering the new UI, after which the test expands and work shifts to bug fixes only. Upcoming work includes App Store screenshots and previews, supported by a test server populated with anonymized fake users to avoid compromising actual user anonymity.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am in the final stages of preparing to ship a 2.0 version of a fairly successful app, that has been shipping for a couple of years.

This is a complete, bottom-to-top rewrite (front- and backend). It's a huge improvement. I used an LLM, quite a bit. It's been a big help.
mentions.author: ChrisMarshallNY
